Natural outing/contact and both branches remain unobserved.

witness.sequence: observe, choose, act, repair or rerun when needed, run.witness, run.finish
witness.instruction: Report the smallest supported conclusion for each affected claim. A single statement remains valid; use a caol-playtest-witness-bundle-v1 when one run has independent claim outcomes or a routed defect. Preserve inconvenient evidence without discarding unaffected observations, and stop requesting proof once the charter is honestly settled.

descriptor.termination: run.witness then run.finish to conclude the evidence, or run.quit to end without a claim. Action failures, binding drift, missing receipts, no progress, and client disconnects stop only the current operation and leave the game running.
